name: Medina Palms
summary: Lavish Swahili-style resort on Watamu's Indian Ocean shore, with ocean suites, private villas, a spa and a kids' club.
description:
Medina Palms is a stylish, Swahili-inspired resort on the shores of Watamu, on Kenya's north coast, beside the Watamu Marine Reserve. Accommodation is mostly suites and villas rather than standard hotel rooms. The Medina offers two-bedroom suites, luxury two-bedroom penthouses and luxury three-bedroom ocean lodges, while the Palmerie offers one-bedroom suites and luxury three- and four-bedroom villas, with the Amani Signature Villa at the top of the range. Suites have air conditioning and kitchenettes, and the ocean-facing villas have private plunge pools (per booking listings).

Dining includes the open-air and rooftop Amandina restaurant (Mediterranean, Moroccan and African dishes), The Long Bar for cocktails and tapas, a Coffee Garden and a Beach Bar for seafood lunches. There are gardens with swimming pools, the Sakina Ocean Spa and a fitness studio, and children have the Nemo's Cave kids' club. Windsurfing, kayaking and body boarding are on offer, with snorkelling and diving in the Watamu Marine Reserve, sunset cruises and cultural excursions. Tsavo National Park is about 90 minutes away. The resort also hosts weddings, meetings and special events.
amenities: Suites and villas with kitchenettes and air conditioning
Private plunge pools in ocean-facing villas
Swimming pools set in tropical gardens
The Long Bar and Beach Bar
Snorkelling and diving in Watamu Marine Reserve
child_policy: Kids' club (Nemo's Cave) on site; babysitting is available for a surcharge according to booking listings. Please ask us to confirm child rates and cot availability.
remarks: SOURCES: official site medinapalms.com (rooms, dining, activities, 'two-bedroom suites from $435 per night'); imaraafricasafaris.com, africanspicesafaris.com, hotels.com (plunge pools, kitchenettes, 8-guest 4-bedroom villa). Star rating is not stated by the hotel; third parties give 4 to 5 stars (5 used). Rates beyond the $435 starting figure are on request and vary by season.

name: Nyikani Camp Central Serengeti
summary: Semi-permanent luxury tented camp at the foot of Banagi Hill with wide views over the Serengeti plains.
description:
Nyikani Central is a luxury tented camp in the heart of the Serengeti National Park, set on the elevated slope of Banagi Hill with views over the plains below. It is described as semi-permanent, and the sister Nyikani Migration Camp in the Kogatende area follows the Great Migration. Sources give 11 to 14 guest tents.

Tents have a large bed, writing desk, cupboard, electronic safe and charging points. Bathrooms are en suite with flush toilets and safari-style bucket showers on a pulley system, with toiletries provided. Listings also mention an electric kettle, free bottled water, a bar and a restaurant on site. Park, camping and statutory fees are charged on top of the accommodation rate.
amenities: Luxury safari tents with en-suite bathrooms
Flush toilets and safari bucket showers
Writing desk, safe and charging points in each tent
Bottled water and kettle in the tent
remarks: SOURCES: expertafrica.com (14 tents, Banagi Hill, semi-permanent), timbuktutravel.com (11 rooms), monkey.travel (Nyikani Central and Nyikani Migration Camp, Kogatende). You wrote 'Nyikani Camps and Lodge': no Kenyan property exists under that name; this is the Serengeti (Tanzania) camp. Rates differ widely by source (roughly $250-$510 per person per night plus park fees); none published here.

name: Four Points by Sheraton Nairobi Airport
summary: Contemporary airport hotel with a rooftop pool, all-day dining and an airport shuttle, minutes from JKIA.
description:
Four Points by Sheraton Nairobi Airport is a modern 172-room hotel in the Jomo Kenyatta International Airport area, a short drive or shuttle ride from the terminals (listings differ on the exact distance, from under a mile to about 4 km). It suits arrival and departure nights, business stays and short breaks.

Room categories include traditional rooms of about 28 m² with a king or twin beds, Deluxe King rooms of about 40 m² with a sitting area, 42 m² suites and 67 m² Executive Suites. Rooms have a flat-screen satellite TV, minibar, coffee maker, kettle and rain shower. There is a rooftop heated pool, a fitness centre and a spa and wellness centre, with the Tazama Rooftop Bar and Grill and the all-day Marketplace restaurant, plus 24-hour room service. Check-in is from 3 pm and check-out is at noon.
amenities: Spa and wellness centre with Jacuzzi
Flat-screen satellite TV, minibar and coffee maker in rooms
remarks: SOURCES: marriott.com listing (172 rooms, rooftop pool, check-in/out), porini.com (room categories and sizes, complimentary shuttle), friendlyplanet.com, kayak.com. Marriott pages were blocked for direct fetch, so details are from reliable third parties. Breakfast buffet is charged separately (about USD 25 pp) so the meal plan is set to Room only. Pool had renovation notices in 2022-23: confirm it is open. No rates published.

name: Malaika Tented Camps
summary: Luxury tented camps inside the Serengeti, from central Seronera to the Mara River in the north.
description:
Malaika Camps and Lodges operates luxury tented safari camps in Northern Tanzania. Malaika Seronera Luxury Camp sits in the heart of the Serengeti National Park, with spacious tents that have en-suite bathrooms, private decks and lounge areas. Malaika Mara River Luxury Camp is the northern camp, beside the Mara River where the Great Migration crossings take place. Booking sites also list Malaika Ndutu Luxury Camp and Malaika Migration Camp near Lake Ndutu, which is a good base for the calving season.

Because the group's camps are in different parts of the Serengeti, they are easy to combine in one itinerary that follows the wildlife. Tell us your travel dates and we will recommend the right Malaika camp for the season.
amenities: Mara River: northern Serengeti, Great Migration river crossings
Ndutu camps: calving season base (confirm availability)
remarks: SOURCES: atta.travel (Malaika Camps & Lodges Ltd), cheetahsafaris.com (Seronera, Mara River), travelocity/hotels.com listings (Ndutu camps). The Ndutu camps and any Ngorongoro-area camp are NOT confirmed by an official source; check with the operator. Per-room rates seen on aggregators (about USD 400 for two) are dated and not published.

name: Yaya Hotel and Apartments
summary: Four-star aparthotel in Kilimani beside Yaya Centre, with fully equipped one- to four-bedroom apartments.
description:
Yaya Hotel and Apartments is an aparthotel on Argwings Kodhek Road in Kilimani, about a minute's walk from Yaya Centre and a few minutes' drive from Nairobi Hospital. Its apartments and suites range from one to four bedrooms, sleeping roughly two to six guests, which makes it a practical choice for families, groups and longer stays in Nairobi.

Apartments have 49-inch smart TVs with satellite channels and Netflix, memory-foam beds, full kitchens with a fridge-freezer, stovetop and microwave, rainfall showers and free toiletries, with free Wi-Fi and daily housekeeping. The property has a gym, a restaurant and bar, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage and free parking, and listings also mention an outdoor pool.
amenities: One- to four-bedroom apartments and suites
49-inch smart TVs with satellite and Netflix
remarks: SOURCES: travelocity.com, trip.com, expedia.com listings (aggregators only, no official page found). Room count is disputed (one source says 70). Pool details vary by listing: confirm. No rates published. Note: there is no Marriott/Courtyard at Yaya Centre (see report).

name: Keys Hotel
summary: Family-run hotel in Moshi, the gateway town for Mount Kilimanjaro, with garden cottages and a pool.
description:
Keys Hotel is a family-run hotel on Uru Road in Moshi, within walking distance of the town centre and a popular base for Mount Kilimanjaro climbers. It has about 30 rooms: 15 in the main building and 15 African-style cottages set in the garden. Rooms are air-conditioned with minibars and safes (per listings), and on clear days there are views of Kilimanjaro's snow cap.

The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool, a restaurant, a bar and a coffee lounge, free parking and Wi-Fi, and is connected to a shopping centre.
amenities: Views of Mount Kilimanjaro on clear days
Air-conditioned rooms with safes and minibars
remarks: SOURCES: dnatatravel.com, travelweekly-asia.com, contemplativemind.org, cvent.com (Keys Hotel, Uru Road, Moshi). You listed 'keys hotel' among Kenyan hotels; no Keys Hotel was found in Kenya, so this is the Moshi (Tanzania) property. If you meant a different Keys Hotel, tell us. Check-in from 12:00, check-out 10:00 (one listing). No rates published.

name: The Encore Hotel Nakuru
summary: Large four-star hotel in Nakuru with lake-view rooms, a spa, three restaurants and a rooftop-style pool deck.
description:
The Encore Hotel is a four-star hotel in Nakuru town, about a ten-minute drive from Lake Nakuru National Park (listings give 3.7 to 12 km). It has three room categories, each with a king bed and free Wi-Fi: Deluxe rooms of about 31 m² with a partial lake view, Superior Deluxe rooms of about 46 m² with a lake view, and State Suites of about 56 m² with a lake view. Rooms have air conditioning, a laptop-friendly workspace and an in-room safe.

Facilities include three restaurants, a bar and lounge, a coffee shop, a full-service spa, an outdoor pool with a children's pool, a hair salon and laundry services. It works well as a base for Lake Nakuru, with game drives to see rhino, flamingo and buffalo.
amenities: Outdoor swimming pool and children's pool
remarks: SOURCES: hoteles.com, expedia.com listings (aggregators; no official page reachable). Listings disagree on breakfast (free vs surcharge), distance to the park and total rooms (205 per Expedia, unverified), so none of those are stated publicly. No rates published.

name: Four Points by Sheraton Nairobi Hurlingham
summary: Middle Eastern-themed business hotel in Hurlingham with an outdoor pool, gardens and free parking.
description:
Four Points by Sheraton Nairobi Hurlingham is a four-star hotel in the Hurlingham and Kilimani area of Nairobi, themed with Middle Eastern touches. Guests can swim in the outdoor pool, eat at Mezze on the deck or relax in the gardens.

Rooms include Traditional rooms of about 26 m² with two twin beds (sleeping up to three) and Executive Suites with a king bed. They are air-conditioned and soundproofed, with a flat-screen TV, minibar, safe, desk and coffee and tea facilities. The hotel has a gym, a terrace, meeting rooms and a banquet hall, a 24-hour front desk, concierge and free on-site parking. Breakfast is charged separately on most rates.
child_policy: Up to two children aged one or under stay free in a parent's room using existing bedding. Cribs are not provided (per listings; please confirm).
remarks: SOURCES: hotels.com and airshop.gr listings; Marriott's page was blocked for direct fetch. One older listing shows 96 rooms (unverified). Breakfast about KES 2,000 per person (listing), so meal plan is Room only. No rates published.

name: Ol Tukai Lodge
summary: Eco-minded lodge in the heart of Amboseli with 80 chalets, a pool and views of Mount Kilimanjaro across the wetlands.
description:
Ol Tukai Lodge sits at the foot of Mount Kilimanjaro, in the heart of Amboseli National Park, a park famous for its large elephant herds. The lodge has 80 chalet-style twin rooms spread under the trees, each with a private bathroom and terrace, a safe, a fan and a tea and coffee counter. Every room looks onto the wetlands or Kilimanjaro, and two rooms are designed for guests with limited mobility. A family room and the three-bedroom Kibo Villa are also available.

The restaurant opens onto a garden veranda, there is a pool bar, and the Elephant Bar has a roof-level deck overlooking the marshes and Kilimanjaro. Guests can enjoy the swimming pool, a spa and massage, a gift shop, a clinic, a business centre and Wi-Fi, and the lodge has a conference room for up to 200. Activities include game drives (including night drives led by a warden), a short bird walk (about 400 bird species are recorded), Maasai village visits, the elephant research centre, bush dinners and a champagne breakfast at the observation hill.
amenities: Views of Kilimanjaro or the wetlands from every room
Night game drives with a warden
Gift shop, clinic and currency exchange
Two rooms adapted for guests with limited mobility
child_policy: Family-friendly lodge with family rooms (per booking listings; a kids' club and tennis court are also listed). Please ask us for child rates.
remarks: SOURCES: official site oltukailodge.com (facilities, 80 rooms, activities); go2africa, imaraafricasafaris, tribes.co.uk (family rooms, no air conditioning, kids' club). Part of Manrik Hotels & Lodges (same group as Eka Hotel and Kibo Villa). Meal plan Full board per africanspicesafaris.com (park fees excluded). Published rates vary from about $190 to $330+ per person per night and 2026 rates are 'on request', so none are published here.

name: Kibo Villa Amboseli
summary: Private three-bedroom villas near Amboseli National Park with mountain views, a playground and a children's club.
description:
Kibo Villa is a villa-style stay near Amboseli National Park, in the Entonet/Lenkism area of Kajiado, suited to families and small groups. The villas have three bedrooms, with a luxury villa of about 1,290 sq ft and a second villa with a king bed. They have air conditioning, a minibar, refrigerator, in-room safe, desk and satellite TV, with private balconies or patios and bathrooms with deep soaking tubs.

Breakfast is served from 6 am to 8 am. The property has a sauna, a playground, a children's club, a garden with barbecue grills, a snack bar and deli, free Wi-Fi in public areas, laundry and dry cleaning, a concierge and a 24-hour front desk. An airport shuttle is available for a fee. Kibo Villa is part of the same group as Ol Tukai Lodge.
amenities: Air conditioning, minibar, fridge and safe
child_policy: Playground and children's club on site. Babysitting may carry a surcharge. Please confirm with us.
remarks: SOURCES: ekahotel.com (lists Kibo Villa, Amboseli among Manrik group properties), hotels.com, expedia.com, trip.com listings. Listed as 3.5 stars on hotels.com (rounded to 4). Pool and spa appear only on Trip.com: not stated publicly. No rates published.

name: Eka Hotel Nairobi
summary: Four-star business hotel on Mombasa Road beside Nairobi National Park, minutes from JKIA, with the Eka Gardens venue.
description:
Eka Hotel is a contemporary four-star hotel on Mombasa Road at the Southern Bypass junction, next to Nairobi National Park and about five minutes from Jomo Kenyatta International Airport via the Nairobi Expressway. It has around 165 air-conditioned rooms, mostly Superior rooms, with triple rooms, a Junior Suite, Executive Suites and rooms designed for guests with special needs.

The Galaxy restaurant has a terrace overlooking the pool, and there is a Galaxy bar with a bar deck and a 24-hour coffee shop. Guests have a swimming pool, a gym, a spa wellness centre, a gift shop, a concierge desk, free parking and free Wi-Fi. For events there are five meeting and boardrooms for up to 200 people (theatre style) and Eka Gardens, a lawned garden venue with a jogging track and seating area.
amenities: Five minutes from JKIA via the Nairobi Expressway
Five meeting and board rooms (up to 200)
Eka Gardens lawns with jogging track
remarks: SOURCES: official ekahotel.com (location, facilities, Eka Gardens, Manrik Hotels & Lodges group). The site shows 163 rooms in one place and 167 in another, so 'around 165' is used. 'Eka Gardens' in your list is this hotel's garden and events venue. No rates published.

name: CityBlue Creekside Hotel & Suites
summary: Creekside hotel on Nyali Road overlooking Tudor Creek, with a pool, gym, two restaurants and family connecting rooms.
description:
CityBlue Creekside Hotel & Suites stands on Nyali Road beside Tudor Creek in Mombasa, with about 100 rooms across three floors. Deluxe, Superior and Twin rooms have creek or garden views, and some have balconies or patios. Rooms are air-conditioned with en-suite bathrooms, a TV, refrigerator and minibar, and several connecting rooms suit families.

The hotel has an outdoor pool, a gym, a bar and two restaurants, including Gourmet A La Creek, a business centre, laundry and dry cleaning, and free on-site parking. An airport shuttle is available for a surcharge. A buffet breakfast is served from 7 am to 10 am for a fee, and a 300-seat meeting room is available for events. Check-in is from 2 pm and check-out is at 10 am.
remarks: SOURCES: kayak.com, trip.com, successfulmeetings.com listings; official site citybluehotels.com was blocked. 'City Blue Hotels' is a group: this is the Mombasa creekside property. If you meant another CityBlue hotel, tell us. Star rating not confirmed (4 used). Buffet breakfast is extra, so meal plan is Room only. No rates published.

name: Mombasa Continental Resort
summary: Beachfront resort on 8.3 acres at Shanzu Beach, with 175 rooms, six restaurants and bars, a spa and large conference facilities.
description:
Mombasa Continental Resort is a beachfront resort on 8.3 acres of tropical gardens at Shanzu Beach, on Kenya's Swahili coast north of Mombasa, with direct access to the beach and the Indian Ocean. It has 175 air-conditioned rooms: Standard rooms with garden views, Deluxe rooms with a pool or partial sea view, and Superior rooms with a direct sea view. Rooms have a minibar and safe, most open onto a balcony or patio, and suites are also available.

There are six restaurants and bars, including the Frangipani main restaurant and The Dhow beach restaurant for grilled seafood and coastal specialities, plus swimming pools with a poolside bar. Vidzo Spa offers a full treatment menu and there is a fully equipped fitness centre. Water sports, dhow cruises, snorkelling and marine excursions are available, and kids' programmes run at the resort. Extensive conference facilities hold more than 700 people. All-inclusive rates are offered on some bookings.
amenities: Direct beach access on Shanzu Beach
Rooms with garden, pool or sea views
remarks: SOURCES: official mombasacontinental.com (175 rooms, 8.3 acres, six bars/restaurants, Gold Quality Mark award), expedia.com and trip.com listings (room types, ~250 sq ft rooms). Star rating not stated by the hotel (4 used). Guest reviews are mixed (older rooms): check recent reviews. Not to be confused with the separate 'Mombasa Continental Hotel'. No rates published.

name: Eka Hotel Eldoret
summary: Modern four-star hotel in Eldoret with an indoor pool, spa, fitness centre and well-equipped business rooms.
description:
Eka Hotel Eldoret is a four-star hotel with about 85 rooms in the western Kenya city of Eldoret, part of the Manrik Hotels & Lodges group. Rooms include Standard Double rooms with a queen bed and city view (about 323 sq ft) and Business rooms with a king bed (about 463 sq ft). They have a 42-inch smart TV with premium channels, air conditioning, a minibar, kettle and coffee and tea maker, bathrobes, slippers, premium bedding with a pillow menu, blackout curtains, a rainfall shower with bidet, a desk, an in-room safe and free Wi-Fi.

The hotel has an indoor pool, a spa with massage and treatment rooms, a fitness centre, a restaurant, two bars and lounges and a coffee shop, with a 24-hour front desk, laundry service and free parking. Breakfast is a buffet charged separately.
amenities: Spa with massage and treatment rooms
remarks: SOURCES: hotels.com, priceline.com, expedia.com listings (4 to 4.5 stars; 4 used); ekahotel.com confirms it is a Manrik group hotel (ekaeldoret.com). Rooftop pool appears on one listing only: not stated publicly. No rates published.

name: Merica Hotel
summary: 94-room hotel on Kenyatta Avenue in central Nakuru with an outdoor pool, restaurant, gym and meeting rooms.
description:
Merica Hotel is a 94-room hotel on Kenyatta Avenue in the heart of Nakuru, a convenient base for Lake Nakuru National Park and the Rift Valley lakes. Rooms are mostly Deluxe and Superior rooms with a queen or king bed, a 32-inch flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a rainfall shower, free toiletries, a wardrobe, an electric kettle and free Wi-Fi, and some have a pool view.

The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool, an on-site restaurant serving breakfast, lunch and dinner, a bar and lounge, a terrace, a gym and spa massages. There is free self parking, concierge service and a lift, and the hotel offers meeting rooms and a business centre for conferences.
remarks: SOURCES: priceline.com, hotels.com, expedia.com, amimagazine.global listings; the official site (merica.co.ke) was blocked. Star rating ranges from 3 to 4 on listings (4 used). Breakfast included on some rates only; check-in times vary: confirm. No rates published.

name: Lake Naivasha Crescent Camp
summary: Rustic tented camp near Lake Naivasha with about 20 rooms, a garden, a restaurant and a short walk to Crescent Island.
description:
Lake Naivasha Crescent Camp is a tented camp on Moi South Road outside Naivasha town, within about a fifteen-minute walk of the Crescent Island Wildlife Sanctuary. It has about 20 rooms with wooden floors and en-suite bathrooms with hot and cold showers. A Deluxe room of about 19 m² sleeps three, with one double and one single bed, and rooms have a fan, blackout curtains, a hairdryer, a desk, an in-room safe and free bottled water. Guests describe it as rustic, with basic amenities.

There is a restaurant serving breakfast, lunch and dinner, a bar and lounge, a garden and terrace, barbecue grills and a picnic area. Laundry service, bicycle rental and meeting rooms are available, and boat trips on Lake Naivasha can be arranged. A continental breakfast is listed as included.
amenities: Boat trips on Lake Naivasha (can be arranged)
remarks: SOURCES: hotels.com, expedia.com, monkey.travel, roomertravel.com listings. 'Naivasha crescent lodge' in your list is read as this camp (the property is not on Crescent Island itself). 3.5 stars on listings (3 used; reviews describe it as rustic). Pool appears on one listing only: not stated publicly. No rates published.
